title: Crafting Reversible SFT Behaviors in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.06632v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) induces new behaviors in large language models, yet imposes no structural constraint on how these behaviors are distributed within the model. Existing behavior interpretation methods, such as circuit attribution approaches, identify sparse subnetworks correlated with SFT-induced behaviors post-hoc. However, the fine-tuned model may still carry the behavior through other pathways, so such subnetworks offer no guaranteed handle for selectively controlling SFT-induced behaviors at inference time. We pursue a constructive alternative by asking: can an SFT-induced behavior be deliberately compressed into a sparse subnetwork, termed a *carrier*, that is sufficient for the behavior and, by construction, necessary for it, while remaining controllable at inference time without weight modification? We propose (a) **Loss-Constrained Dual Descent (LCDD)**, which constructs such carriers by jointly optimizing routing

translated_title: 在大语言模型中构建可逆的SFT行为
translated_abstract: 监督微调会在大语言模型中诱发新的行为，但对这些行为在模型内部的分布方式没有施加任何结构约束。现有的行为解释方法（如电路归因方法）只能事后识别与SFT诱发行为相关的稀疏子网络。然而，微调后的模型仍可能通过其他路径携带该行为，因此这类子网络无法保证在推理时有选择性地控制SFT诱发的行为。我们寻求一种构造性的替代方案：能否将SFT诱发的行为有意地压缩到一个稀疏子网络（称为“载体”，carrier）中，使得该载体对该行为既是充分的、又在构造上是必要的，同时在不修改权重的情况下于推理时保持可控？我们提出：（a）损失约束双重下降方法，通过联合优化路由……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出损失约束双重下降方法，可将SFT诱发的行为构造性地压缩到稀疏子网络“载体”中，该载体对行为既充分又必要，从而在不修改权重的情况下实现对大语言模型微调行为的推理时可控与可逆操控。
